name: rawdrive
description: RawDrive — India's Premium Photography SaaS Platform
author: Manyam Prasad <manyamprasad@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && if command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then golangci-lint run --config ../.golangci.yml ./...; else go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.12.2 run --config ../.golangci.yml ./...; fi
scripts.uat: NODE_PATH=./node_modules node tools/cobolt-uat.js run --milestone M39 --mode build --base-url http://localhost:3000 --json
